_comment: Ground-truth business state. The factory cannot fake these numbers.
_published_schema: Each entry: { asin, title, platform, price_usd, published_date, cover_path, manuscript_path }
_published_note: A book is PUBLISHED only when it has a real ASIN from Amazon. A PDF on disk is NOT published. Only a human can add entries here after publishing on KDP.

thresholds._note: 30 days after first publication with zero sales = the market has spoken.
